ns2:course.label: Introduction to Classical Japanese
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the grammar, morphology, vocabulary, and style of classical Japanese language as found in premodern Japanese literary and historical writings. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Three years of modern Japanese language or equivalent.
